responsibility: Implements the Go frontend lexer, converting source files into tokens while managing semicolon insertion, numeric and string literal decoding, UTF-8 and Unicode identifier handling, keyword recognition, source locations, compiler directives such as pragmas, `//go:linkname`, and `//go:embed`, and low-level comment skipping. It also contains the Unicode classification tables and exported-name tests used by the parser and symbol logic.
same_name_distinction: Contains the lexer implementation behind `lex.h`: keyword lookup tables, token storage mechanics, actual scanning of source text, directive/comment handling, and Unicode classification data/functions. Unlike `lex.h`, it is the concrete scanner and Unicode-table implementation rather than the token and lexer API declaration.
